title: spec(data): `ObjectSchema` declares an object's default row scope — the existing RLS policy shape minus `object` — applied when no held permission set carries a policy for it (#24164 ruling E′)
body:
Filed by the director seat (summon #43 continuation 5, `session_01QJC7i981TSs9L1CGJK59Ax`) from objectstack-ai/objectstack#24164, ruled E′ by the maintainer on 2026-10-18 (batch #365 item 4; the ruling comment on that card carries the ten binding terms). The object declares its default row scope; the platform identity objects declare theirs. This is the spec half; the collection point is the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) (`domain:services`), the declarations and the registry rule are the declarations card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) (`domain:engine`), the ADR note is the ADR-note card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) (Tier H). ⛔ Not a claim. `Clause-②: yes (widening)`.

## What changes
- `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` `ObjectSchema`: one optional key — the object's default row scope — typed as the existing `RowLevelSecurityPolicySchema` (`packages/spec/src/security/rls.zod.ts:239`) without `object` (implied by the declaring object). The lane picks the key name (for example `defaultRowScope`): one name, declared once; its describe() states the semantics — applied by the security plugin's one collection point when no held permission set carries a row policy for this object; an authored set policy wins as authored; superuser bypass untouched; absent = today's behaviour — and names its reader (the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)) and its writers (the declarations card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)).
- Generated JSON schema, forms, docs, the liveness-ledger row and the authorable-surface baselines by the repo's tooling, never by hand (precedent for a spec addition: PR #24152, +318/−7). The ledger row reads pending-reader until the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) lands.
- Tests in `packages/spec`: the key parses a policy without `object`; a policy carrying `object` is refused; unknown keys are still refused.

## Acceptance
- `pnpm check` green, baselines regenerated, changeset `minor` on `@objectstack/spec`.
- No runtime behaviour changes until the collection-point card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164) lands.

## Dispatch notes
- `packages/spec/**` is not governed; the PR must not touch `docs/adr/**` (that is the ADR-note card (filed in this act; numbers in the ruling comment on #24164)).
- Review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` (schema face, `Clause-②: yes`).
